title: Tokyo Named World's Fourth Safest City to Visit
paragraphs: Tokyo is one of the world's biggest cities, but it is also one of the safest. According to a new ranking, it is now the fourth safest city in the world to visit.

The ranking was published in October 2026 by Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection, an American travel insurance company. Every year, the company makes a list of the safest cities for travelers. This list is for 2027.

To make the ranking, the company chose 38 popular cities for American travelers. In August 2026, it asked more than 1,500 people if they had visited these cities, and people who had visited a city were asked how safe it was. The company then combined the answers with information from other safety rankings and gave each city a score.

Montreal, in Canada, was first, with a score of 82.18. It moved up from 16th place last year. Zurich, in Switzerland, was second, and Amsterdam, in the Netherlands, was third. Tokyo was fourth, with a score of 79.91, up from ninth place last year. It was the highest city in Asia on the list. Reykjavik, in Iceland, which was first last year, fell to fifth. Copenhagen, which was second last year, fell to 12th.

Tokyo did especially well for safety on public transportation, where it was second. It was also third for safety from violent crime. In addition, Tokyo was second on the list for parents and third for older travelers.
However, Tokyo did not do as well for LGBTQIA+ travelers. It was ninth on a separate list for this group.
Other cities in the top 10 were Oslo, Singapore, Venice, Sydney and Honolulu. The only other city in Asia in the top 15 was Singapore, in seventh place.
The company says that the ranking is only a starting point, and travelers should always check safety advice before they travel.
